owner: Pricing Agent-A4 / Used Parts Pricing Logic Owner
purpose: Rules for used parts price, floor price, confidence and manual review decisions.
floor_price_rules: floor_price must be above purchase_cost unless clearance approved
floor_price must include minimum margin target when known
high-value parts require manual review before floor reduction

pricing_confidence_rules.high: 3 or more relevant competitor prices and clear condition match
pricing_confidence_rules.medium: 1-2 competitor prices or similar category match
pricing_confidence_rules.low: no direct comps, rare part, unclear condition or conflicting fitment
